sources.entry: Table Habit – Habit tracker with growth charts and offline-first sync. ![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/table-habit/id6744886469?platform=mac)

summary.one_liner: Table Habit (mhabit) is a free, open-source Flutter habit tracker for micro habits, with a scoring system, growth charts, and optional WebDAV sync across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
summary.what_it_does: The app tracks habits with a scoring system meant to measure consistency beyond streaks, and shows growth curves over time with separate scoring models for "do" and "don't" habits. Habits can have custom colors and be grouped, collapsed, and drag-and-drop reordered. Data can be imported and exported as JSON and migrated from Loop Habit Tracker CSV files. Sync is done through WebDAV (the README names Nextcloud, Koofr, and self-hosted servers), and the app is described as fully usable offline with no account or telemetry. Translations are handled through Weblate, with RTL language support.
use_cases: sync habit data across devices via WebDAV
offline habit logging without an account
how_to_run: git clone the repository, then cd mhabit
notable: Scoring model that goes beyond streaks, with separate models for 'do' and 'don't' habits
WebDAV sync to Nextcloud, Koofr, or self-hosted servers, with no vendor lock-in
Loop Habit Tracker CSV import and native JSON import/export
Community translations via Weblate with full RTL support
Available through many channels including Homebrew, Scoop, Flathub, F-Droid, and the App Store
caveats: Sync is WebDAV only for now; other sync backends are listed as planned
Android home screen widget is still in progress; iOS widgets are in beta
The README describes the project as a one-person indie project
